stories.title: Prince Waikiki Holiday offers, give back and get festive
stories.summary: Give back, catch holiday performances and plan a Waikiki staycation with seasonal activities and kamaaina offers at Prince Waikiki this holiday season on Oahu.

stories.title: Tanker’s steering failed minutes before it crashed into cruise ship, NTSB says
stories.summary: A tanker ship had two minutes between a steering failure and its collision with a cruise ship on the Mississippi River, according to the NTSB.

stories.title: ‘Just tragic’: 18-year-old Georgia football commit dies after sudden medical emergency
stories.summary: A community is left heartbroken after the death of a Georgia football commit who suffered a medical emergency.

stories.title: First Alert Forecast: Breezy trades, passing showers for much of the coming work week
stories.summary: Occasional shower bands will move through the state, but heavy rainfall is not expected.

stories.title: Woman and her dog killed after being hit by car, police say
stories.summary: A woman and her dog died after being hit by a car in central Phoenix on Saturday evening, police said.

stories.title: ‘Disrespectful’: Video shows men touching monk seal in West Oahu
stories.summary: The recording shows one man touching a monk seal with his foot, then the person recording the video touched the seal with their foot a second time.

stories.title: Hawaii musicians honored with Lifetime Achievement Awards
stories.summary: The Lifetime Achievement Award recognizes musicians who are at least 60 years old and have spent 20 or more years in Hawaii’s music industry.

stories.title: Pearl City Public Library closes for $35M renovation and expansion project
stories.summary: The project is expected to begin this winter and take approximately three years to complete.

stories.title: City to begin road rehabilitation project on Kapiolani Boulevard
stories.summary: The City and County of Honolulu’s Department of Design and Construction is scheduled to begin a road rehabilitation project on Kapi’olani Boulevard.

stories.title: Crews search for boater after mayday call off Sand Island
stories.summary: A mayday call sent crews looking for a boater about two miles off Sand Island Saturday night.

stories.title: Deputy kills man accused of shooting at him during gun show
stories.summary: A suspect who died after shooting at a Lexington County deputy working security at this weekend’s South Carolina Arms Collectors Association gun show has been identified.

stories.title: Week Ahead in Washington: November 15
stories.summary: President Donald Trump heads to Asia for critical meetings with world leaders and Congress returns to Capitol Hill ahead of Thanksgiving. This is your Week Ahead in Washington for the week of November 15.
